## edac81ec2559

**Reproduced control/API defects.** Source SHA-256 is `6b4dbf2be9e9d89080db201e5bca0eed7cbd94dbd1ac7efafb27c28a3aa559a0`; no `RULE_HASH` is declared. `checks/audit/edac81ec2559/probe_controls.py` and `checks/audit/edac81ec2559/control-contract-report.json` test the public generator contract at fixed seed/sample index.

Four advertised axes are pixel-dead: every tested value of `palette_kind`, `density`, `n_distinct_colors`, and nondegenerate `texture` returns a byte-identical grid to the unoverridden call. Advertised endpoints are also unreachable at default difficulty: `grid_h=4/14`, `grid_w=4/16`, and `marks=1/20` are declared valid but rejected by narrower runtime ranges. On easy with `marks=1`, 40 draws produce 1–4 nonzero mark cells, showing that the control counts blobs rather than exact marked cells.

The scalar boundary accepts `seed=True`, `seed=1.5`, `sample_index=True`, `sample_index=-1`, and `difficulty="extreme"`; all returned grids pass the target’s own `self_check`. The combined audit report `checks/audit/edac81ec2559-combined/result.json` additionally fails because no semantic contract is declared and no task-local tests are present. These are reproduced source-bound defects, not suspicions. No target source was changed.
